aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential due to higher leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.
